task_description: Restructure both V2 notebooks to match the methodology diagram order: Training NGBoost (fixed params) BEFORE Hyperparameter Tuning, add Analisis Kalibrasi and Prediksi Kualitas Air as separate sections, Evaluasi compares before vs after tuning

verification.summary: Both V2 notebooks restructured successfully. Valid JSON, all code cells parse with ast.parse. Section order matches diagram: EDA -> Preprocessing -> SMOTE-ENN -> Training NGBoost (fixed params: n_estimators=300, lr=0.05, minibatch_frac=0.8, col_sample=0.8, max_depth=4) -> Training Baselines -> Hyperparameter Tuning -> Evaluasi (before vs after comparison) -> Analisis Kalibrasi -> Prediksi Kualitas Air -> Counterfactual -> Constraint Evaluation -> Prescriptive. Kadiwal uses Bernoulli, Canada uses k_categorical(5). All existing content preserved (McNemar, ROC, KDE, Confusion Matrices, Feature Importance, CV, DiCE, WHO/Permenkes/CCME).
